payload.rationale: The contract resolves 'yes' if the rounded one-decimal seasonally adjusted monthly CPI-U for September 2026 is 0.3% or higher. Core CPI in August 2026 rose 0.3%. Furthermore, high-frequency EIA gasoline data shows retail prices rising from $4.207/gal at the end of August to $4.455/gal by mid-September, an increase of approximately 6%. With gasoline having a relative importance of 3.77%, this price surge is expected to add roughly 0.2 percentage points to the headline CPI. Combined with a steady core CPI, the headline figure is highly likely to reach or exceed the 0.3% threshold.
limitations: Gasoline prices for the second half of September are unknown and could reverse.
Core CPI components and other energy/food prices are not fully visible and could surprise to the downside.
Seasonal adjustment factors can introduce unexpected volatility into the final printed number.
